caption: The drawing depicts a single drinking glass, shown in a vertical orientation at the center of a blank, off-white background. The glass is rendered in shades of green and has a slightly conical shape, being wider at the rim and narrower at the base. The rim is round and smooth, and the glass has a short stem or a thickened area at the bottom which transitions into a circular, slightly scalloped base. Light reflections and shading details are present on the surface of the glass, suggesting its transparency and glossy texture. Below the drawing, handwritten text in cursive reads, "Toddy Glass" and "Missott's Jewel," with small cross-like guide marks above and below the illustration. There are faint age-related stains and some discoloration on the left side of the paper.
title: Toddy Glass
